statement: ControlPlaneSnapshotOwner uses owner-authored ready-lease bounds, not heartbeat-cadence age, for cache freshness: staggered active-node heartbeats within unexpired leases yield fresh snapshots, while expired or missing lease evidence remains stale and schedules bounded repair. Red-on-revert producer-owner-consumer tests and one production MovieLens run prove preload admission observes the fresh outcome without accepting stale or blind snapshots.
